_meta.model: telescope focus (D, F_tel) -> ideal collimator f_col (= F_tel x W) -> collimated beam / pupil of diameter W -> ideal camera f_cam -> detector. Effective focal ratio = f_cam / W; pixel scale = 206265 x p / (D x F_tel x f_cam / f_col).
_meta.rule: Every value carries src (key into sources), loc, and a short verbatim quote from a document saved unmodified under rawdata/imaging/<inst>/ or an existing rawdata/presets/ file (existing round keys reused: KTG02, VLTSPE, FUM117, AR92, FD300V, EUT, CS98N9/N11/N15, D11, BD03, LCOUM, LCOT, O95, KLDET, KLH, M10, M12, MDDR, MPSR, KMD). derived = arithmetic done here from sourced values (shown). alternatives = other sourced values (conflicts). 'NOT FOUND' marks a gap; no value is filled from memory.
_meta.quote_check: Every quote (and every alternative's quote) was machine-checked by scripts against the extracted text of the saved file: pdftotext -layout and -raw for PDFs, an HTML-to-text pass for web pages, an astropy header dump for the FITS file, tesseract OCR for the two scans without a usable text layer (AR92 and the NIRC2 mask drawings, KNRM). Normalisation: NFKC, curly quotes/primes/dashes/minus/tilde/multiplication signs mapped to ASCII, '|' table separators dropped, whitespace collapsed; a piece may also match after joining hyphenated line breaks or with all spaces removed (pdftotext glyph spacing such as 6.' 8). fors2.title: VLT (UT1 Antu) / FORS2 imaging (IMG) -- all-dioptric focal reducer at the Cassegrain focus; standard-resolution (SR) collimator, high-resolution (HR) collimator as the alternative
fors2.summary: complete. Telescope from the VLT interface spec (entrance pupil 8115.0 mm set by M2, f/13.4106, 108827 mm, 528 um/"; M2 1116 mm -> eps = 0.1375 DERIVED; M1 f/1.8). Optics from the manual and ESO's instrument page: f_col 1233 mm (SR) / 616 mm (HR), pupil 90 / 44.5 mm (published; 91.9 / 45.9 mm DERIVED as f_col/F), f_cam 280 mm, final f/3.13 / 6.25; broadband filters in the parallel beam, interference filters in the converging beam. MIT mosaic: 2 chips of 4096 x 2048 x 15 um stacked in y, one gap of 480 um (32 px DERIVED) with 30 um x-offset and 0.08 deg rotation. Field: SR limited by the MOS unit in the focal plane to ~6.8' x 6.8' (7.1' x 7.1' nominal; mosaic covers 8.6' DERIVED), HR limited by the CCDs (4.2-4.3') with camera-lens vignetting in the corners. Validation: 0.12591"/px measured (SR, unbinned; DERIVED 0.12519), HR 0.06323 (DERIVED 0.06255). Gaps: no source states the gap in pixels or the pupil position relative to the filter wheels; W published (90 mm) and W = f_col/F (91.9 mm) differ by 2%.
fors2.recommended_preset: SR collimator, MIT mosaic, unbinned 15 um pixels (the default imaging readout is 2x2 binned = 0.25"/px). D = 8.115 m (entrance pupil, set by M2; 8.2 m = M1), eps = 1116/8115 = 0.1375 DERIVED (secondary alone, sky baffle retracted), F_tel = 13.4106 (Cassegrain), f_col = 1233 mm, W = 1233/13.4106 = 91.9 mm DERIVED (ESO quotes a 90 mm pupil), f_cam = 280 mm (effective f/3.05 DERIVED; manual f/3.13), filters in the collimated beam (broadband) or converging beam (interference), detector = 2 rows of 1 chip (4096 x 2048 each, 15 um) with a 480 um (32 px) gap between the rows, field = 6.8' x 6.8' square (MOS-unit limit). Validate: 0.12591"/px measured on Antu (model 0.12519 DERIVED, -0.6%), 0.25"/px binned, field 6.8' x 6.8'. HR alternative: f_col = 616 mm, W = 44.5 mm (45.9 DERIVED), final f/6.25, 0.06323"/px measured (0.06255 DERIVED), field 4.2-4.3' square limited by the CCDs with vignetted corners.

The two chips are offset 33" from the optical axis so that the field centre falls on chip 1 (unbinned y ~ 238 of chip 1 in SR, FUM117) and the gap falls between two MOS slits (FMIT).

imacs_f2.title: Magellan I (Baade) / IMACS f/2 ("short") camera imaging -- refractive collimator on the f/11 Gregorian Nasmyth focus, straight-through f/2 camera (the spectrograph presets use the f/4 camera)
imacs_f2.summary: complete. Baade 6.5 m at f/11 (71526.4 mm, 1998 design), primary f/1.25, central obscuration 29% (measured for the twin Clay telescope; secondary baffle). Collimator 1648.46 mm with a 150 mm pupil (round-4 records). f/2 camera: 355.6 mm (BD03 Table 1, CS98N15), f/2.38 imaging -> f_cam / W = 2.37 DERIVED. Filters: 165-mm square filters in a Filter Server in the converging beam just in front of the CCD; narrow-band filters at the pupil. Detector since Dec 2017: Mosaic3, eight 2K x 4K x 15 um E2V CCDs in a 4 x 2 array = 2 rows of 4 chips; gaps 1.37 mm (91 px) between long sides (within a row) and 1.08 mm (72 px) between short sides (between rows). Field: the 8192-px mosaic spans 28' with gaps; light is unvignetted to R = 12', ~10% vignetted at R = 15', and baffled beyond (corners dark) -> 670 sq arcmin (DERIVED 676 for a R = 15' circle on the mosaic). mosfire.summary: complete; everything optical is the round-4 MOSFIRE record (data/round4/mosfire.md), re-quoted here: Keck I Cassegrain f/13.66 (0.72516 mm/"), f_col 1813.0 mm, f_cam 250.0 mm (design values, confirmed by the as-built 7.25x reduction), W = 132.7 mm DERIVED (125.0 mm 'stipulated' at f/14.50), H2RG 2048 x 2048 x 18 um (17.984 um at 77 K), 0.1798"/px. New here: imaging uses the mirror back-to-back with the grating; the double filter wheel sits in the collimated beam just before the pupil wheel (170-mm filters tilted 6 deg; Lyot stop at the pupil); the field is the 2040 x 2040 active area (6.113' square) intersected with a 6.9' (414") circular baffle in front of the field lens; Keck obscuration 0.24 (H17). Gap: as-built f_col / f_cam / beam not published (design values used).

Validate: 0.1798"/px (model 0.17985 DERIVED with 17.984 um), 6.1' x 6.1' field, 6.9' circle.

nirc2.title: Keck II / NIRC2 -- near-IR camera behind the Keck II AO system (f/15 AO output); collimator, cold pupil-mask wheel, two filter wheels, three selectable all-reflective cameras (narrow 10 mas, medium 20 mas, wide 40 mas)
nirc2.summary: telescope, AO output, detector, field and pixel scales complete; the internal optics (collimator and camera focal lengths, pupil size) are NOT published in any source found. AO output: f/15 with the telescope's f-ratio and pupil position (KNG, KTG02), i.e. the Keck f/15 focal length 149.6 m -> F = 13.66 for D = 10.95 m; obscuration 0.24 of the 10.93-m circumscribed pupil (H17). Optical train (KNOM): focal-plane slit/mask slides (also the per-camera field baffle) -> collimator -> pupil-mask wheel -> two 18-position filter wheels (collimated beam, near the pupil: the aperture masks sit in filter-wheel slots, T06) -> grism slide -> one of three cameras ('all reflecting, gold-coated', KTG02) -> Aladdin-3 InSb 1024 x 1024 x 27 um. Robust DERIVED values (from the published scales only): camera/collimator magnification f_cam/f_col = 3.744 (narrow), 1.877 (medium), 0.938 (wide); effective focal ratio at the detector 51.2 / 25.6 / 12.8. Inferred values (DERIVED from Tuthill's aperture-mask drawings, flagged): pupil scale 2.303 mm per metre of primary -> W = 25.2 mm, f_col = 344 mm, f_cam = 1290 / 647 / 323 mm. Validation: 0.009942"/px (9.952 mas pre-2015, 9.971 mas after the 2015-04-13 realignment), 0.019829, 0.039686"/px; fields 10", 20", 40" (detector-limited).

collimator_focal_length.derived: DERIVED (inference, not a published value): the NIRC2 9-hole and 18-hole aperture masks (hole centres in mm, pp. 1, 3) are mirror images of Tuthill's Keck pupil masks drawn on the 36-segment primary (pp. 2, 4): a similarity fit of hole centres gives 64.714 (9-hole, 9 holes, rms 1.6 drawing px) and 64.740 (18-hole, 18 holes, rms 1.9 px) drawing px per NIRC2 mm; the segment grid on the same drawings gives 116.17 px per half flat-to-flat = 0.7794 m (segments '1.8 m across the corners', KTG02) = 149.05 px/m. Pupil scale = 149.05 / 64.727 = 2.303 mm per metre of primary (2.5 mm holes -> 1.086 m, cf. '110cm holes'). The masks sit in filter-wheel slots (T06), i.e. at the NIRC2 pupil. Then f_col = 2.303e-3 x 149.6 m = 344.5 mm (because W/D = f_col/f_tel).

notes: Read this preset as two tiers: tier 1 (sourced or robust DERIVED): D, eps, F_tel, f_eff per camera, f_cam/f_col magnifications, effective focal ratios, detector, fields, scales. Tier 2 (inferred DERIVED, flagged): W = 25.2 mm and f_col = 344 mm from the mask drawings, hence the absolute f_cam values. Changing W leaves the pixel scale, field and effective f-ratio unchanged.

Mask-drawing fit (KNRM, DERIVED here): circle centres were measured on 200-dpi renderings of pp. 2 and 4 (ring-filter peak finding; radii 86 and 42 px), NIRC2 hole centres were read off pp. 1 and 3 (OCR confirms several: '(2.52110,7.85996)', '(-9.58012,6.11331)', '5.92876,7.20237)', '-9.20181,1.53327)', '6.10974,-4.08020)'); the best similarity transform is a mirror image with ~0 deg rotation, residual 0.27% of the pattern radius. Segment grid: horizontal hexagon edges every 116.14 px (p. 2) and 116.21 px (p. 4) = half the 1.5588-m flat-to-flat of a 1.8-m (corner-to-corner) segment.

AO relay: K-mirror rotator, OAP collimator imaging the primary on the 349-actuator DM (7 mm pitch = 56.25 cm on the primary, KTG02), second OAP restoring f/15 and the pupil position; NIRC2 therefore sees the telescope's f/15 beam and pupil geometry (eps, spiders).
Coronagraph spots and the vortex masks sit in the focal-plane slit slide; Lyot stops are the pupil masks (fixedhex since 2019, KNOM). Not part of the imaging preset.
